answer_1.quote: We propose a new generation-based task to directly generate sub-event sequences in the free-text form... We propose SubeventWriter to generate sub-events iteratively.
answer_1.outputs: sub-event sequences (free‑text steps describing how to accomplish a process)

answer_2.quote: For each pair of a predicted sequence and a ground truth sequence, we compute BLEU-1, BLEU-2, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore between them...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to complement automatic evaluation... Three experts are asked to evaluate every sub-event, yielding ... We decompose them and score every sub-event in the following 3 aspects: Relevance, Conciseness, Orderliness.
